title: A People’s Foundation
summary: Substack essay urging Committees of Safety and common-law grand juries as a Creator-based authority of "the people" over institutional government.

assertions.quote: Each CoS being established, may then resolve to create a common law grand jury to referee between institutional government and ‘the people’.

verdicts.note: Only grand juries summoned by courts under statute have legal power; self-convened ones have none.

assertions.quote: the whole theory of its function is that it belongs to no branch of the institutional Government

verdicts.note: United States v. Williams (1992) says this, but of court-summoned grand juries, not self-convened ones.

assertions.quote: change the form of its people to mere business (person) entities held to statute and code
